title: Where is Pip?
text:
Bima has a brown hen called Pip. Every day, Bima gives Pip some rice.

One morning, Pip is not in her box. Bima looks under the table. He looks behind the door. Where is Pip?

Then Bima hears a cluck in the garden. Pip is sitting in the long grass. Bima picks her up. Under her, there is a warm egg! Bima smiles. 'Thank you, Pip,' he says.
